skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target and gains [Specialized HP] equal to 120% of own ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 400% ATK DMG. Grants allies in the same row [Specialized Acceleration] for 1 round, increasing their SPD to 92% of Sonic’s SPD. If an ally’s original SPD is higher than the increased value, their SPD remains unchanged. Removes 3 Energy from the enemy team, up to once per round. After Energy is successfully removed, [Panic] cannot be triggered during the same round.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 600% ATK DMG. Grants allies in the same row [Specialized Acceleration] for 1 round, increasing their SPD to 96% of Sonic’s SPD. If an ally’s original SPD is higher than the increased value, their SPD remains unchanged. Removes 5 Energy from the enemy team, up to once per round. After Energy is successfully removed, [Panic] cannot be triggered during the same round. After casting the Ultimate, gains 1000 Fighting Spirit points.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, applies [Encourage] to all allies. When Sonic uses his Ultimate, has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Burn] on enemies hit. [Encourage]: Grants 2 Energy at the start of each round for 3 rounds. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 150% ATK as DoT DMG for the next 3 actions, then disappears.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, applies [Encourage] to all allies. When Sonic uses his Ultimate, has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Burn] on enemies hit. [Encourage]: Grants 3 Energy at the start of each round for 3 rounds. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 200% ATK as DoT DMG for the next 3 actions, then disappears.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, applies [Encourage] to all allies. When Sonic uses his Ultimate, has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Burn] on enemies hit. [Encourage]: Grants 3 Energy at the start of each round for 5 rounds. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 250% ATK as DoT DMG for the next 3 actions, then disappears.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently gains 25% [Specialized Acceleration]. When attacking, if the main target’s SPD is lower than Sonic’s SPD, deals [True DMG] equal to 500% ATK. Permanently gains a 65% chance of [Instant DMG Evasion]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, True DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently gains 30% [Specialized Acceleration]. When attacking, if the main target’s SPD is lower than Sonic’s SPD, deals [True DMG] equal to 500% ATK. Permanently gains a 65% chance of [Instant DMG Evasion] and grants allies in the same row a 45% chance of [Instant DMG Evasion]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, True DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

effects.desc: Debuff applies to all enemies when their Energy is reduced, blocking or destroying their Energy, making them unable to use their ultimate.
Power up at the beginning of each round for several rounds.
The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
Speed ​​buff that while in effect allows the bearer and up to 6 allies to act against and overcome enemies with lower speed.
Damage over time effect, dealing ST-based damage to target over 3 turns.
Increases ally's speed to near deployer's speed (remains the same if ally is already faster).
